name: com.lenovo.lsf.lenovoid.ui.PsLoginCommonActivity
description: This Lenovo ID screen handles email-and-password or phone-and-password sign-in. The SDK opens it from the main login page or through the email/phone login actions; it also links to recovery and code-based login.
disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Lenovo ID with an email or phone number and password.
